svg.title: BENDING SPOONS · HARVEST: 115 merged PRs in 13 weeks; #1 contributor on the team this quarter; 6.7× faster assignment page 2.7s → 0.4s; $5M ARR product rebuilt natively inside Harvest
svg.text: Rebuilt Forecast, Harvest's decade-old sister product, natively inside Harvest: owned architecture, data models, APIs and delivery across
capacity planning, scheduling, utilisation and plan-vs-actual.
Built a self-serve import that brings Forecast customers' scheduling history across without loss.
Kept the planning engine interactive across 1,000-day horizons, 20k assignments and 2,000+ projects. Also shipped milestone billing,
project tags and permissions, and gave 48 code reviews.
